arguments.text: 8000 m race, 8 legs of 1000 m out-and-back. Pacer sets effort. Me: watch for weed on rudder (sudden speed loss at same pod power, clear_rudder fixes), pod drift (pod power vs boat power vs heart rate diverge slowly; correct with pod_gain belief), wind/current shifts, radio course changes (set_race_distance + tell). Keep the computer honest; few cues. Baseline ratio boat/pod power about 0.66-0.68 at start.

arguments.description: boat-model power over pod power; drops with weed or extra drag, drifts with pod gain

arguments.text: t=600s: share fell 0.69->0.63 but pattern fits a current stronger near the start line: push_local leg1 +0.41 near start, +0.35 at 1000m; leg2 -0.20 at 1000m, -0.26 near start; mean offset ~+0.075 both places. Test on leg 3 (out, from start): if push_local near start ~+0.40 again it is current; if ~+0.30 it is drag/pod/blade. Pod reserve model 15% at 10 min, empties ~2500 m at 170 W: if paddler holds 170 W past that with HR flat, raise CP.

arguments.text: t=781s (2424 m): 4-window hull fit share 0.658 (0.654-0.664), push 0.27 out / -0.27 back, uniform current (my near-start current idea was wrong). Still-water speed at ~171 W pod fell 3.08 -> 3.04 between legs 1-2 and legs 2-3 (about 4% power): small, watch for pod drift or blade fatigue. Pod reserve model hit 0 at ~2400 m; paddler now 8/10 close to limit (was 6/10 at 7 min); HR 175, flat-ish. Keep CP 155 unless paddler holds 170+ W for 3 more min without fading.

t=898s (2809 m): GPS speed fell 3.33->3.21 from 814 to 894 s while pod only 176->170 (speed drop ~3x what pod explains); boat share 0.59, fade -5%. Paddler said legs going at 825 s; HR 176 flat. Sent clear_rudder at 898 s to test weed. If speed recovers after: weed. If not: pod drift (gain up, true effort falling) or real blow-up hidden; then consider pod_gain belief. Turn at 3000 m (~60 s after cue) muddles the after-minute: compare leg 4 vs leg 2 too.
